criteria.name: Iterable vs element is unmistakable
criteria.asks: Can a reader see that `others` is a collection and `other` is one element, without being told the convention first?

criteria.name: Cross-iteration timing is unmistakable
criteria.asks: Does the picture say "available next turn, not this one" — the single thing the source code says with a re-assignment and nothing else?

criteria.name: Survives the hard semantics
criteria.asks: Tuple unpacking, several loop variables, filter/continue, an empty iterable, nesting, break and for…else.

criteria.name: Ink economy — a simple loop stays simple
criteria.asks: Marks added per loop, and whether the return path becomes the bundle of parallel arrows Zach already rejected.

criteria.name: The dataflow reading survives
criteria.asks: Every value still travels a visible path. Nothing teleports between two marks the reader has to pair up by name.

criteria.name: Fits SystemSketch's shipped seams
criteria.asks: Block ports with inner/outer faces, the `temporal` StyleProp and its z⁻¹ pill, Branch's region-as-port-host, stock tldraw. Invention cost.

criteria.name: Adds no node
criteria.asks: Hard constraint. Anything that introduces a Block, gate, pill node or state node scores zero and is out.

v4.name: Header Contract
v4.owner_unpack: the wall, named on a header row
v4.owner_delay: the row itself — the return line runs along it
